title: Pipeline Step Extraction
description: One extracted data-analysis pipeline for a single paper, attributed to a single target author. A paper produces one document of this shape per target author for whom there is supporting evidence in the Methods text (per the tiered attribution scheme in prompts/author_attribution.md). Every field must be traceable to the paper's actual text; if a value is unknown or absent from the source, it must be recorded as null rather than inferred or omitted.

paper_id.description: The Zotero item key (8-character alphanumeric ID) for this paper — the canonical identifier used throughout the project instead of filename or DOI.

journal.description: Name of the journal the paper was published in.

target_author.description: Name of the target author this pipeline is attributed to. By convention this should match one of the entries in config/project_config.yaml's target_authors list, but that list may grow over time so it is not enforced here as an enum.

attribution.description: Evidence basis for attributing this pipeline to target_author, per the tiered attribution scheme in prompts/author_attribution.md.

source.description: Which tier of evidence supports attributing this pipeline to target_author: an explicit author contributions statement, inference from Methods text (e.g. named responsibility for a technique), or a position-based heuristic (e.g. author order).

confidence.description: Confidence in the attribution itself, independent of extraction_confidence on individual steps.

pipeline_steps.description: Ordered sequence of data-analysis pipeline steps extracted from the Methods (and Methods-relevant Supplementary) text.

step_order.description: 1-based position of this step in the pipeline sequence as described in the paper.

category.description: Broad category of the technique performed in this step.

technique.description: Short name of the specific technique or method used in this step (e.g. 'two-photon calcium imaging', 'linear mixed-effects model').

software_tool.description: Name of the software or tool used to perform this step, if the paper names one. Null if no tool is named.

tool_version.description: Version of software_tool, if the paper reports one. Null if not reported or if software_tool is null.

parameters.description: Free-form key-value pairs of parameters reported for this step (e.g. frame rate, filter cutoff, sample size). Not schema-constrained beyond being an object, since parameter names vary widely by technique. Use an empty object if no parameters are reported.

input_data_type.description: Type of data consumed by this step (e.g. 'raw fluorescence video', 'spike times'). Null if not determinable from the text.

output_data_type.description: Type of data produced by this step (e.g. 'deltaF/F traces', 'place field maps'). Null if not determinable from the text.

hardware.description: Hardware used to perform this step, if named (e.g. microscope model, electrode array). Null if not reported.

source_location.description: Whether this step was described in the paper's main Methods text or in a Methods-relevant Supplementary section.

source_quote.description: A short verbatim quote from the source text supporting this step, or null if no single quote captures it. The real constraint is <=15 words, which JSON Schema cannot enforce directly (it cannot count words) — the maxLength of 120 characters here is only a rough soft proxy. The 15-word limit must be checked by whoever performs the extraction, not by schema validation.

extraction_confidence.description: Confidence that this step was extracted correctly and completely from the source text, independent of attribution.confidence.
